description: Manages app navigation state and links the top-level navigator to the app environment. Handles platform-specific integration, deep links, Android back button, and state persistence.

usage.dynamicAPI: Use <NavigationContainer> directly in your component tree.

refMethods.navigate: Navigate to a screen by name with optional params.
refMethods.goBack: Navigate back to the previous screen.
refMethods.isReady: Returns true if the navigation tree is ready (at least one navigator mounted).
refMethods.resetRoot: Resets the navigation state of the root navigator.
refMethods.getRootState: Returns the current state object of all navigators.
refMethods.getCurrentRoute: Returns the route object of the currently focused screen.
refMethods.getCurrentOptions: Returns the options of the currently focused screen.

addListener.ready: Fires when the navigation tree is mounted.
addListener.state: Fires whenever the navigation state changes.
addListener.options: Fires whenever the options change for the currently focused screen.

props.initialState: Provide initial state for deep linking, state persistence, etc.
props.onStateChange: Callback triggered every time the navigation state changes.
props.onReady: Callback triggered after the container and children finish mounting.
props.onUnhandledAction: Callback for actions not handled by any navigator.

linking.description: Configuration for deep links and URL integration.
linking.prefixes: Array of URL prefixes to handle.
linking.config: Structure of navigators for parsing paths.
linking.getInitialURL: Custom function to return initial URL (async supported).
linking.subscribe: Custom function to handle incoming URLs with listener.
linking.getStateFromPath: Override how paths are parsed into navigation state.
linking.getPathFromState: Override how navigation state is serialized to path.
linking.getActionFromState: Override how navigation state is converted to actions.

props.fallback: React element to render while resolving deep links (default null).

documentTitle.enabled: Boolean to enable automatic title updates on Web (default true).
documentTitle.formatter: Custom function to format title based on options and route.

props.theme: Custom theme for headers, tab bars, etc.
props.direction: Text direction: 'ltr' or 'rtl'. Defaults based on I18nManager.
props.independent: Wrap with NavigationIndependentTree for multiple independent navigation trees.

notes: Use ref for dispatching navigation actions outside a screen.
isReady ensures safe dispatch of actions before navigation tree mounts.
Avoid nesting multiple NavigationContainers unless using NavigationIndependentTree.
linking integration works with deep links, Firebase notifications, and web URLs.
onStateChange is called with new navigation state; consider state as internal and subject to change.
